headline: An outdoor launch built around the trail.
alt: Hiker in a rust jacket walking into the wooded foothills
challenge: A fictional outdoor label needed launch creative that felt rooted in real trail use and could work in both wide and vertical formats.
solution: The concept follows one hiker from the city edge into the foothills. A hero film provides the story, with shorter edits planned for social launch and product discovery.

headline: A sharper campaign for a new drink.
alt: A red drink can and citrus on a warm orange studio set
challenge: A fictional beverage brand needed a creative system that could stand out on a small screen and support affordable early testing.
solution: Bold product photography anchors the launch. Multiple hooks and crops test product discovery, flavour appeal and the first-purchase offer.

headline: A quieter website with a clearer next step.
alt: Minimal concrete staircase and strong architectural light
challenge: A fictional architecture practice needed a portfolio that could show larger projects and help prospective clients judge whether to get in touch.
solution: An image-led project index, concise service pages and a prominent enquiry path connect the work to the studio’s business goals.
